column1: # `few [2..4]int32` in a fixed root, the message form. Probe.schema is the
# unit; every .bin is a whole message batch of one body (the form byte, then
# the body), read against the unit's own announcement. The reference engine
#   msg-birth-stored is the birth value (two zero elements) STORED, the 11
#   bytes the writers that did not elide it emitted: a field stored at its
#   declared default, refused. The other two are its controls.
# write <case> <count> <verdict> <wire>: a fresh Root whose `few` has that
# live count, every element zero; measure, then save the batch of one.
# `refused` owes a refusal from both (a writer that refuses in every build;
# an assert leg answers from its debug build), `wrote` owes <wire> byte for
# byte. Count -1 is for a target whose record carries a settable live count;
# a target whose count is its array's length runs the others.
